title: Metabolomics and machine learning select six serum markers for sleep apnea in hypertension
summary: In 559 hypertensive patients with and without obstructive sleep apnea, three machine learning algorithms selected six metabolites for a diagnostic model, with AUC 0.995 (96.8% correct) in the discovery sets and 0.997 (99.1%) in the validation sets (116 non-OSA, 158 OSA). The metabolic phenotype pointed to oxidative stress and inflammation. The very high AUC and the absence of an external site call for caution.
ai_technology: Three machine learning algorithms integrated to select discriminatory metabolites for a diagnostic model
organization: Beijing Anzhen Hospital, Capital Medical University; Beijing Institute of Heart Lung and Blood Vessel Disease

evidence.tested: Separate validation set from the same study.
evidence.unknown: External-site validation and clinical use are not reported; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selected the six-metabolite panel and built the classifier.
